name: Paggu

sources.title: Homepage — blog with 'Submit' menu containing 'Submit StartUp/SaaS Product' and 'Submit Guest Post'
Submit Your StartUp/SaaS Product — 'submit your details below... we would write a review for it if it matches our criteria'; free with optional paid fast-track

requirements: New startup or SaaS product — the editor visits your website and writes a review 'if it matches our criteria'
Submission is free; a 'small fee' can jump the queue for an immediate review
Alternative channel: message the owner on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/eamitabh/)
Guest-column route is separate: exhaustive, 100%-unique articles ≥1200 words in Entrepreneurship, Startups, or Digital Marketing
preparation: Product name, URL, and a short description of what the startup/SaaS does
A few paragraphs of write-up if pitching a startup story (helps the editor publish faster)
Live, presentable website — the editor reviews the actual site before deciding
workflow: Submit the startup details via the comment form at the bottom of that page (the page instructs 'submit your details below' and the only on-page form is the reply box)
Optionally send the same pitch via the owner's LinkedIn as a follow-up
Wait for editorial review — accepted products get a review article in the Website Reviews category
watchFor: Submission mechanism is informal — a WordPress comment box, not a structured form; keep the pitch self-contained
Editorial discretion: no guarantee of publication; criteria are unstated
Optional paid 'jump the line' upsell mentioned on-page
Site is a small personal blog (Amitabh Shukla); recent posts date to 2026 so it is still active
countsAsLive: A review article about the product is published on paggu.com (typically under /website-reviews/)
unknowns: What criteria the editor applies when deciding to review a submission
Review turnaround time and the size of the 'small fee' for expedited review
Whether links in published reviews are follow or nofollow
